results.title: Janelle Monaé Unveils 'Phish Boy' Character at Wondaween Festival
results.description: Janelle Monaé showcased her creativity at her Wondaween festival by debuting an original character, 'Phish Boy,' a dapper figure with bugging eyes and hyperrealistic fins. The event, themed 'Creature Carnival,' featured performances from fun. and Lil Nas X, and attendees enjoyed a night of music and elaborate costumes.

results.title: GRiZ Announces Relocation of Seven Stars Festival After Learning Venue's Plantation History
results.description: Electronic musician GRiZ revealed that his annual Seven Stars festival will be moved from Oakridge Farm due to the property's dark history as a plantation. In a statement, GRiZ expressed accountability for the decision and condemned the online hatred directed at those who raised awareness of the issue.

results.title: Criminal Minds: Evolution Unveils Final Season Plan and Upcoming End
results.description: Paramount+ announces that Criminal Minds: Evolution will finish with a final season, scheduled for 2027, marking the first Skydance‑approved cancellation following a merger, while veteran cast members reprise their roles alongside newcomer Zach Gilford.
